nom: Naturium Plant Ceramide Rich Moisture Cream

avis.titre: I am on my third jar
avis.texte: This product is so smooth when put it on. It makes my face feel soft and I don't wear makeup.

I have very dry skin thats prone to post inflammatory hyperpigmentation and unevenness in tone. I've had a hard time finding something hydrating enough that doesn't leave me looking too shiny or feels like its just sitting on my skin. I've seen an improvement in my overall skin tone and texture since starting and the pores on my nose look smaller. I plan on restocking and seeing if the improvements continue with a second jar

This product claims to be fragrance free but it does have a scent that gave me a headache. Also, this cream sat on top my of skin and didn't seem to absorb. After applying it at night, my face was quite "greasy" in the morning.

avis.titre: I don't want to be without it!
avis.texte: This cream lives up to its name! It's a lovely, rich cream that keeps my skin hydrated. I love Naturium products!

avis.titre: Not for acne prone or sensitive skin
avis.texte: I have different textures on different parts of my face. My forehead gets dry and loved this cream. The rest of my face broke out from how badly this clogged my pores. I would say if you have dry non-acne prones skin, this would be good. But if you're acne-prone by any stretch, it's a pass.

Love this moisturizer!!! I have very dry skin and this is the only product that makes my skin feel nice and hydrated all day without leaving it greasy. It's like butter melting on your skin without any greasiness. I have been noticing less fine lines as well!!! This is the only product that does not lie. You literally only need a tiny bit to keep your skin nice and hydrated all day. The smallest jar will last longer than a month.

1) This is a thicker cream, which I prefer, but it takes a lot to spread over and cover my face, so about half the jar was used in 10 applications. 2) Despite being thick, there is something in this cream that dried out and irritated my face, giving it sore red spots. I know hyaluronic acid dries out skin. Maybe the rosemary extract was irritating too (fyi my skin is mildly sensitive). 3) I do like the natural ingredients and no microplastics though.
Love the packaging and quality of this product. It doesn't have a strong scent and it's very moisturizing. Great for mature skin and protects the facial layer exposed to the environment.
It's very moisturizing and pairs well under foundation. It leaves my skin hydrated and glowing.

I bought this product about a month ago. I have combo skin with an oily but also dry T Zone. The packaging is very cute and the cream is a nice texture. It does feel moisturizing and light weight but my skin gets very oily and greasy overnight if used at night time and instantly after putting makeup on during the day. I also think this has been breaking me out in places I don't normally get pimples, on my chin + cheeks. Also, sometimes if I exfoliate before using this it makes those exfoliated areas very sensitive and almost burns.

avis.titre: is OFF with the jumbo product!
avis.texte: I have been using this product for more than 5 years now and since the last 2 bottles I've been breaking out, bad! I've sent the previous bottle back after reaching out to customer care, the product seperated from the oils, the replacement I got was better but I can see and feel that the consistency is different. What happened?!! I have terrible break out on my chin and cheek when I use it, and I tested it by not applying for 4 days and the skin skin was healing. As soon as I reapplied new pimples and irritation started. I have never had this happen in all those years of daily apply. What happened with the product? I have been using the jumbo version since it came out.. so sad about this happening to my skin, but I'm actively looking for another moisturizer. The Natrium sunscreen is still amazing on my skin, but something is off with the jumbo moisturizer!

avis.auteur: Put this in airless pump for perfection
avis.texte: Dr vanita rattan approves the ingredients but needs to be in an airless pump to be perfect. Even if you avoid using your fingers into it and contaminating it, the air makes the ceramides less effective with time.

This stuff is like gold. I will repurchase over & over. Tried more expensive brands recently and had horrible irritation and issues with fragrance. So glad I came back to Naturium! A little goes a long way, and you wake up glowing!

i have mixed feelings about this product. i purchased it because of glass packaging (although the lid is plastic), "clean" ingredients, and cruelty free. i use it at night and while my combination skin feels good after waking up, it's an offputting texture for me. in the jar i received, the cream isn't really creamy…it doesn't hold together. it faintly reminds me of ricotta cheese. this sensation is amplified when rubbing it in, it's not cohesive on the skin and doesn't fully rub in. i won't be buying again for this reason but i'd consider recommending to someone else if they were not texture-sensitive.

avis.titre: Very Moisturizing but the consistency is terrible
avis.texte: I feel like this could be an extremely great, rich moisturizer, but it separates so badly and feels like I just end up rubbing oil all over my face. I have to shake it really good before each use and then it never fails when I open it to use it a big glob falls out on to my sink, so I've ended up wasting a lot of product. It never fully mixes together, so its not creamy. If you look across reviews seems there is a consistency issues across the board. I will say tho, it doesn't irritate my skin in any way, and it never caused me to break out. The oils in it keep my skin really moisturized, especially after a tretinoin treatment.
Love this cream, it makes my skin feel so smooth after application!
Love this face moisturizer cream. It moisturizes without leaving my face greasy feeling
It was given as a gift and made my skin clear you don't need to use so much but I love how it clears my skin. Other moisturizers made me breakout but this one doesn't and I love it.

avis.titre: Me and my BF love it
avis.texte: Suitable for various skin types, I have dry, my BF is more oily and this has been great for both of us.
I can't say enough good things about this moisturizer. My combination skin feels hydrated and not too oily. It's a must have for me.

I am 68 & have dry/combination skin. This cream is very plumping & moisturizing, though I do usually add a small amount of moisturizer over it, once it's absorbed. It doesn't take much product. I've noticed it doesn't seem great with my makeup (maybe I need to do very, very little). I usually use on a non-makeup day & every night. I do like this product & definitely recommend it. I didn't care for the Tranexemic Acid (did next to nothing for my mylasma & dark spots, nor did I like the Vitamin C product). That said, they may work better for some people. Just didn't do anything for me.

avis.titre: A must try at least once.
avis.texte: It's very creamy and you actually only need a small amount.A little goes a long way

I wanted to like this but it didnt work out. I liked how thick but it just sat on top of my skin. It didnt sink in and allow my skin to absorb it if that makes sense. And when applying it would start to roll off like it didnt mix well with my other products that i applied first.

I'm 67 years old & I find that this cream, which has a nice, luxuriant feel - is fabulous. It adds a nice plumping while adding moisture to my skin. I do also add a small amount of CeraVe Revitalizing Night Cream, as I often need additional moisture. I think this product is very good & improves my skin. It doesn't cause my skin to breakout & I can definitely still get those from some products. I am not fond of the Naturium Tranexemic Acid (did next to nothing for my Mylasma & Hyperpigmentation). I also didn't think the Vitamin C worked well for me.

I am repurchasing this ceramide moisture cream because my extremely dry skin loves it. I however, would love it more if the contents didn't separate as it sits in the jar overnight. I was stirring it last night before using it and the glass jar slipped out of my hands and shattered on my ceramic tile floor. Maybe Naturium should rethink using a glass container for this product.
Was excited about this product, but it made me break out. It also doesn't absorb well into the skin. I was hopeful because I love this company too!

avis.titre: Saved my acne prone skin (for real)
avis.texte: As an acne girly of 10+ years I've struggled in the skincare game. BUT this moisturizer is the first one I've used that never breaks me out and leaves my skin glowing. I use it AM & PM. Worth a try!

avis.titre: Saved my acne prone skin (for real)
avis.texte: As an acne girly of 10+ years I've struggled in the skincare game. BUT this moisturizer is the first one I've used that never breaks me out and leaves my skin glowing. I use it AM & PM. Worth a try!

I had to return this product after trying to for a week. The biggest con of this product is the irritation. I have sensitive dry skin and this moisturizer wasnt really soothing. The texture was more like a balm rather than a cream, making it feel more emollient rather than hydrating. This product is also marketed as fragrance free, however, it had a eucalyptus-like scent. Overall, I think there are better thick moisturizers out there.
I like many other naturium products but this one isn't for me. I don't think it's good for acne prone skin. It's greasy and weirdly not the most moisturizing.

This moisture is way to thick and oily for me my face was so shiny all day long and when I would put makeup it would even so thick. Definitely not for me. If you have combination skin I would say don't get it. But if it didn't work for me, doesn't meant it wouldn't for you :)

Not even kidding...it's probably the best night cream I've ever used! You can use it during the day too, but it's a little rich for me for that purpose. I tried the multi peptide rich cream and couldn't finish it before coming back to this...it's just too good. Please never ever discontinue this. Just go ahead and get the jumbo, it's that good. So rich and feels so emollient on your skin. It's like a hug for your face...absolutely will keep buying this as long as its made. It layers so well on top of serums also. I'll often go in with the retinaldehyde cream serum followed by the multi peptide serum and then this last. It feels amazing.
Its a nice thick face moisturizer. I use it at night and feels and looks great. Hydrating and last all night.
Its a nice thick face moisturizer. I use it at night and feels and looks great. Hydrating and last all night.
It has a really nice feel but the natural scent of this product smells like a hint menthol mixed with rubber tires. The only reason I returned it.
i have hormonal acne and this is the only moisturizer that doesn't make my breakouts angry! it feels so nice on my face and locks in all my skincare products for the day or night!

I got two healthy sized samples with an order so I had plenty of time to see how this works. I was so disappointed as all the other products I have tried were great. This cream was a thick, heavy paste and was not moisturizing at all. I won't be purchasing this item.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again
avis.texte: This product doesn't bother my allergies. It's a semi rich face cream for day and nighttime routine for more mature and/or dryer skin type.I find it absorbs quickly on to the face,however, I find that I still have to use a Rose,Squalane or marula oil at night after applying this cream. My morning routine, I use a peptide serum,then this product and sunscreen. It works nicely and it's affordable!

this makes my dry skin look and feel like it's actually nourished and moisturized. at first I didn't care for the smell (all of their products are unscented but can smell a bit weird bc of the ingredients) but this 2nd jar doesn't bother me as much. please never discontinue this!

I've been using this face moisturizer for probably about 2 years and I adore it. I use it every day after my serum and it's perfect for my skin that has always been dry, and is starting to age at age 40. My face does not look or feel 40!
Works great as a night moisturizer, over trentinoin. Rich texture but not occlusive. Good for combo-dry acne prone skin.

I always thought i had to spend a lot of money to get good skin care. Not so! I love all the Naturium skin care. It is amazing! I have been using only a short time and already notice improvements. Love love love this line!

Plant Ceramide Rich Moisture Cream: First time I've used it and very happy with how it feels, how easy it is to massage into my face, a little goes a long way and the packaging is sleek and great price point. I will be adding more of Naturium products.
very lightweight, works great for me and i have combination oily/dry skin

avis.titre: Not for acne prone skin, stop recommending it
avis.texte: I loved this cream at my boyfriend's house. He uses it everyday nothing happens . I bought my own and now I'm suffering from extreme acne . My face looks horrible . They said use it for disrupted skin barrier but no, don't use . I have breakouts everywhere. I think Naturium products as a whole is a fail for me

I received this as a sample and promptly ordered the largest dize I could! This rich mousturizer is perfect for my combination skin….really soothes dryness and is not yo heavy for oily spots. Feels like it balances my skin. And no fragrance so not irritating. I will never be eithout this!

I received a sample of the product with a previous order. I loved the moisturizer but, alas, my acne prone skin did not love it. I experienced breakouts and it wasn't worth risking the resulting hyperpigmentation. HOWEVER, I was searching for a lip moisturizer—something hydrating and not just oil/gloss/shine. (Hydration and moisture both mean water should be present, semantically, but this is often not the case in product advertisement.) . I started trying this product and I won! It's a great base for lips: under lipstick, stain, lip masks. So I'm ordering more, solely for my lips.
love how hydrating and soothing this is, love the price, saved me from buying Tatcha
I love this stuff. Never stop making it. Great under makeup, long lasting. Very nice consistency.

I absolutely LOVE this product! It makes my skin glow., I am 65 and I have had comments on nice and smooth my skin is since I have been using this. This is going to be my Christmas gifts for my besties!

avis.titre: Free Sample - now my holy grail
avis.texte: Naturium had included a free sample of this moisturizer in my last 3 orders. I was getting annoyed because I wasn't using it and it felt wasteful! The cream looked extremely thick and although I have dry skin, I am extremely acne prone so I typically steer clear of thick creams. A few weeks ago I ran out my moisturizer, I had these 3 samples and figured I would use it until I could order my normal moisturizer. A few nights and it wasn't breaking me out, so I figured I'd keep using it. After about week I noticed my skin was looking GORGEOUS and like a glazed donut, better than it's ever looked. I thought maybe it was the moisturizer because it was the only thing I had changed. I started using it on my neck and low & behold after about week the skin on my NECK even looked nice. I've now used up all 3 samples and ordered some. It's absolutely incredible and has done more for my skin than any other product. I have no idea what they put in this but it's a GOD SEND. If you have dry, sensitive skin but are still acne prone THIS IS THE MOISTURIZER OF YOUR DREAMS. Pairs amazing with a retinol, I've been using a very thin layer in the mornings and a normal amount at night!

I received a small sample with my last order and was excited to try it because of how rich and emollient it seemed and I had be having issues with relentless dry skin. It has a bit of an herbal smell to it, which makes sense I guess given the plant ceramides. It leaves a bit of a greasy feel, but it's something I don't mind because I typically put it on right before bed anyway. It did do wonders for my dry skin, but in turn broke me out horribly. It took me about two weeks to even consider it might be the moisturizer until I was literally on the website about to order a full-size jar when I read it's not acne safe. Once I stopped using it, my pimples began to heal and no more popped up after. It's too bad because otherwise it's such a nice night-time moisturizer.
Got it as a free gift, its a great moisturizer, but i would spend my own money on it for the facts that it smells horrendous
I've bought multiple of these jars and panic when I run out. It's a MUST for dry skin, especially in the winter. It is thick but doesn't feel too heavy sitting on top of your skin.

Naturium is the skincare brand that has wowed me in 2023-2024. Love so many of their products and ditching more expensive products in lieu of their formulas. I have another more expensive cream that I like a lot but this does exactly the same thing when I use it at night to seal everything in. I have about 5 Naturium products in rotation at the moment and have my eyes on a few more. They make high quality skincare for great prices. Can't go wrong!
Maybe I got a bad batch but this was so thick I can't even spread it. I have to use nearly 1/5 of the container when I apply. Not a hit.

My feelings are divided for this product, I like the product especially because my skin is not so oily because of the climate but I had trouble picking up the product out of the container, meaning it's slippery, and I end picking up more product than I need but other than that it's good.
I am hooked. My aging skin was drinking this up. I have combination skin and no greasy feel at all.

I got this as a sample and I love it first I just used it at night but now I use it for my morning routine on more dry days because it absorbs into the skin after a while so it does not appear to greasy like at first and I use a little less in the morning than at night. I do use another moisturizer after at night to really seal it in. The big jar is also a lot of product and even the sample had a good amount.

I have tried ALOT of moisturizers and this is just the BOMB! I actually LOVE putting this on every night. Its rich, not sticky, not too thick, just a velvety cream that leaves your skin hydrated all night and into the morning. The smell i love too, clean smell! I got this as a sample and i will be getting the big jar for sure! Great job Naturium!
I received a sample with my order. This is so moisturizing and feels so good on the face. Will definitely order this when I order again.
I received this as a free sample. It seems to have separated and oil pools at the top. I have to mix the product before use. It's a good moisturizer just not sure if something is off with mine

It's a nice cream that smells so horrible that it is unusable. It smells like some kind of cleaning product. I have a general feeling of walking into a public bathroom that was just mopped when I put this on, and the smell never goes away. One star for the cream being nice, minus all the stars because I will never use it because I can smell it forever after I put it on. Absolutely nauseating. I don't understand how this made it into production.

I received a sample of this cream with my order. I now can't live without this. Definitely a winter product for me as it is very thick and rich, but melts into the skin beautifully. My angry skin was significantly more calm after only 2 nights use. I will be purchasing forever!

This was recommended as a 'dupe' for a more expensive moisturizer I was using, but I love this even more. I have been using this for about 2 years and I keep going back to it. I have dry skin (at age 50) and struggle to keep my skin hydrated. This moisturizer does the trick - has a great consistency, doesn't feel super heavy and feels like it is nourishing my skin. I use a few Naturism products and this is one of my faves!
I received the sample size 2 weeks ago and bought the bigger jar. Leaves your face super soft but not too greasy/thick !
I have horrible eczema on my face in the winter and I have only been using this moisturizer for 2 days and it has showed a world of difference!! It's incredible!
I received a sample of this with my previous order and will definitely be adding it to my cart. It's so creamy and dreamy. It lays perfectly under makeup and absorbs right into the skin.

avis.titre: I refuse to live without this
avis.texte: *I have normal skin and I am 30yo I literally always keep backups cause I am afraid to be without this cream. Initially, it comes out as a thick cream but when it's worked into the skin it melts and becomes the softest and most nourishing moisturizer ever. It leaves my skin radiant and super soft but not greasy. 10/5 stars.

In the winter months, I've started developing eczema and this product has saved my skin. I've never struggled with dry skin before this winter season, and this has nourished and hydrated my skin so well. I wish they would make this into a body formula!

Bought this based in reviews from other rosacea sufferers. It made my rosacea flare on my cheeks (super bumpy and red) and broke me out on my forehead and chin. Definitely patch test before slathering up your troubled skin!

I got this as a free sample with another purchase. When I opened it, the moisturizer was thick and dry and didn't spread. I mixed it with my finger and it was fine after that. The smell isn't the best but it's not super strong. It is too greasy for my face and doesn't sink in for a long time. I've been using it on my feet and hands before bed and it's great for that! Not a bad product but not right for me.

I can't get enough of this cream! Worth every penny. I have sensitive yet very dry skin. This keeps my skin moisturized the entire day. I personally use this both day & night. I'm curious to see how my skin will adjust to this once the weather warms up but this has been my saving grace during these cold & windy days.

Love this moisturizer. Such a life-saver for my dry skin in the winter. It's super thick and creamy but not overly so (heavy and greasy). I've bought and finished three of these! My only thing is that the container is small so I find myself having to repurchase every month and a half or so. Will continue using this!

avis.titre: My jar had mold in it.
avis.texte: Was excited to try this, however when I open the jar there were black dots in the cream and right on top of the lid indicating that it was riddled with mold. Contacted customer service did not get any reply whatsoever.

I got this to wear on my super dry winter hands overnight but haven't experienced super moisturizing yet after a few nights. It's not bad but I've had better penetrating moisture with cerave's skin renewing overnight cream (lower price point) or with the biossance squalane cream (more expensive, super rich). So it's fine, but not great on the moisture front
I like this product. It's a great a thick and creamy night cream. It's not greasy and feels really rich and moisturizing. The only thing I don't like is the smell, it smells very plant based.
I love it! My skin needed hydration and this cream made all the difference. I have Rosacea and this cream did not give me a reaction. This is my new go to.

avis.titre: works decent for my dry skin
avis.texte: i got this as a free sample and i have been using it for several weeks now. first, the positives: it hydrates my dry skin pretty well, and it makes my nose appear less oily than it normally would when i wear makeup. the hydration lasts all day. now, the negatives: it is VERY thick and it has an unpleasant, sort of chemically smell. when you put it on, it definitely feels like there's a layer over your face, which i'm not personally a fan of. i would give this 3.6 stars if i could. overall, it does work, but it smells kind of bad and it has an uncomfortable sensory feeling (for me). however, i think i will continue to use this until i can find something that has the same benefits without the cons listed here.
It's very creamy, dense. A little goes a long ways. Soaks into my skin and doesn't sit on top. It's not greasy. I like it and will purchase again

avis.titre: Always love this moisturizer 3 time buying
avis.texte: I love this moisturizer it so good and you don't have to use a lot

I love thick night creams. This honestly is the best of all time. It's feel expensive and so hydrating. I look forward to use it every night, works great with Tretnoin. Most importantly doesn't break me out. Im obsessed with this brand. Never gonna change it.

I got this as a freebie for making a large order a few months ago and since I ran out of my normal moisturizer I decided to give this a shot. Let me say, I'm never going back! This product beats my expensive moisturizers by a long shot! Luxurious, creamy, rich and perfect for dry winter skin. If you're on the fence, try it

I'm into skincare & ive tried quite a few brands /products but i was never consistent with moisturizers bc i'd use a serum then spf & call it a day. However i came across the plant ceramide & wanted to give it a try. It has such a nice feel , pleasant scent & i saw a couple of reviews mentions how it has a luxurious feel & i agree. You dont need a lot & i feel you'd still be able to cover your whole face.

I got this as a free sample in my order (I adore Naturium) That being said, I hate this moisturizer. The texture is great and i'm sure the ingredients are too, but the smell is so potent that it made my eyes water so bad I had to wash it off. I prefer their other unscented moisturizers.

avis.titre: Great final moisturizer, esp for winter!
avis.texte: I love this moisturizer so much. It's kinda thick like Shea butter but not quite there. I use it at night as the last step in my routine.

I got this as a sample in my order and thought nothing of it. I've tried naturium moisturizers before and I liked them but I never loved them. I started using this as an eye cream at first because the sample size looks like an eye cream but one day I just decided to try it as a face moisturizer and immediately was impressed. I have eczema and very dry, sensitive, acne prone skin so it takes a lot for me to truly fall in love with a product but I love this. My skin has gotten even more dry because of the transition into winter which also causes my eczema to flare up A LOT - I'm talking flaky, itchy, red, irritated skin. This does tingle a little bit but it lasts only a second or two. It is so moisturizing so around mid day when my skin starts to flake and I need to reapply moisturizer, I checked my skin and didn't have any flakes. But the main thing that really impressed me was after only two days of using this morning and night, seeing my skin stopped me in my tracks. It looks so much more bouncy and has a healthier glow. My skin also looks much smoother and plump after using this. This is definitely going to be a product I restock on moving forward.

avis.titre: Not a fan of the smell
avis.texte: I got this as a free sample with a recent order and while I love all my other naturium products, this one has a very distinctive smell that I personally don't like. I wouldn't order this intentionally but smells are personal so that's just my two cents.

avis.titre: oily on skin, bad smell, weird solid texture
avis.texte: not sure if i got a bad sample, but i was really disappointed in this product. the product itself smells like a mix of vicks vapor rub and grease paint, it's really oily on the skin and takes forever to sink in (probably due to the shea butter and olive oil which both can be oily and clog pores), and the product in the jar is like, solidified? won't be purchasing.

I just received a mini version as a gift with my vitamin C serum ( by the way thank you) and omg this cream feels so amazing. It's so thick and moisturizing. The only bad thing is , I won't be able to use it because I am acne prone and prone to milia. But for people not acne prone that want a good thick cream this is it. I will use this gifted one on my neck and chest, not letting it go to waist.

The first time I used this I put on way too much product and it felt heavy and greasy and didn't seem like it would ever dry down. I nearly washed it off. Luckily, I decided to give it another try and use less product. It's very rich and a little goes a long way. With the right amount, it's very nice for an evening cream. I think it's too heavy for me to use during the day.

This is an AMAZING moisturizer, it makes my skin feel velvety and smooth. The cream feels silky as you're applying it to your face, neck and chest and it doesn't take much to fully moisturize my skin. I'm very happy with my purchase!

This cream is thick and leaves my skin feeling moisturized by morning when I apply it in my evening routine. I use in conjunction with other Naturium products (cleanser, serum, SPF) and there's been a noticeable difference in just two weeks. A little goes a long way so the jar lasts quite a while.
I have been using this Moisture Cream for yrs, it's the only one I use. It works well, love it.
So I order a body Lotion and got this moisturizer as gift and let me tell you from I smell it and it's fragrance free I said yes this is it my new favorite from natrium

This cream is very thick and melts like butter onto the skin. However, the scent is nauseating for me. Initially it smells very almost minty. Then it changes to a smell that I would describe as old plants.
I really like using this at night! It feels rich and smooth. I do wish that I didn't have to use as much to feel moisturized though. A little does not go a long way.

This moisture cream keeps my face hydrated and soft throughout the night. There are times I wake up in the middle of the night and pat my face and think, 'wow! my face feels great!'. This hasn't been the case for the moisturizers I've purchased over the past few decades, from high end to drugstore. The plant ceramide rich moisture cream feels like a part of my skin. It's not greasy, doesn't have a smell, and works well over other products I put on prior to moisturizing. Note: My skin is normal - dry and I live on the west coast. I only use it at night but might start using it during the day come wintertime. This cream has become my holy grail and is my favorite Naturium product.

I follow her YouTube Chanel and I have always used the pharmacy honey halo moisturiszer, however, she sold me this product, smells very bad and it feels like PONDS cream. Very cheap texture and doesn't absorb on the skin, it lingers on the outside layer for long time. This product is overhyped and I hope more people don't fall for this.
So smooth and creamy. Not overly thick, but moisturizes really well.

avis.titre: Absolutely amazing ceramide cream for combo skin
avis.texte: I don't like cerave but was looking for a good ceramide cream. This is light in texture but rich. I apply to damp skin and it melts in like butter. You only need a small amount. I have combo skin that can be oily but using this as my night cream is amazing. No scent, no irritation or breakouts and no oiliness the next morning. Perfect for after retinol or exfoliating

avis.titre: Great For Sensitive and Dry Skin
avis.texte: I love this moisturizer. I use it in the morning and at night and it makes my skin so hydrated and flawless. My husband who has rosacea also uses it and its gentle enough and hydrating enough for him.
I love the way this makes my skin feel. A little really goes a long way.

avis.titre: Best night cream on the market
avis.texte: Perfect moisturizer that is thick and creamy, but doesn't leave my skin feeling greasy. Love that it doesn't have a scent.

I received this as a sample, and I see several reviews for that time frame.... So I'm here to be honest. If you have acne issues even a little, do not use. I do not have acne prone skin and this broke me out every night that I put it on. I woke up to a new spot. It is slightly greasy and just a little tuff to rub around skin because it is thicker than most moisturizers. It also has a really unpleasant smell like rubber tires. The smell lasts for a couple hours. 2 stars because it is very hydrating but that's if you are willing to trade that for acne and the unpleasant smell
Love love this moisturizer, keeps my skin hydrated and leaves no type of dryness or residue.

Rich and moisturizing. No noticeable smell. I like how in the morning my skin stills feels moisturized and not tight. I have normal to dry skin and it does the job even now that it's warmer it doesn't feel too thick.

avis.titre: Simply just not for my skin
avis.texte: I bought this about a month ago after my sister was using it and really liked it, previously using the nicinamide gel cream, which I really loved, and noticed a significant difference in the look of my skin. I tried it out because I was curious and thought it wouldn't hurt to try. ultimately after using it I can say that this product is simply not meant for my skin type item to have skin that's more on the oily side and I think it's just too rich and heavy of a cream for my skin. After using it, I noticed a not only visible difference in my skin, but also a texture difference with increased oil and Dole, like appearance. My skin became very congested on my cheeks and nose and for head anywhere where I normally produce oil. Generally not a good skin moment lots of under the skin bumps, blackheads and texture that I don't normally have. Also side note when I put it in my skin I should have known immediately it wasn't going to work as it felt like it was just sitting on top of my skin not absorbing. Overall not a bad product I think if you have dry skin this would work really well as the consistency is thicker and richer but if you have more oily skin I would skip.

avis.titre: Great consistency but not for sensitive skin.
avis.texte: I bought this some months ago and really wanted this product to work because I like other products by Naturium. Because of my very dry skin, I was looking for a heavier cream that adds long-lasting moisture, which I did get, but this cream breaks me out. I developed sensitive skin (not because of this product) and I don't typically have active acne unless I am slacking on my skincare or for hormonal reasons so the new pimples are not worth it.

This is a rich moisturizing face cream that I use at night as the final step in my skin care routine. Even though this cream is a rich moisturizer, it is easy to have a light touch when applying this cream and get the right balance of moisturized skin without it feeling too heavy or greasy. For my older middle age skin that tends toward dryness, this is a great moisturizer that absorbs quickly but leaves my skin feeling well moisturized for a good amount of time after application.

Oh my gosh! I absolutely love this product. I use this day and night and it is now going to be my staple in my facial routine. It's so moisturizing and leaves and nice shine to my face. Definitely purchase this if you suffer from dry skin!
I use this moisturizer every morning. It's not too thick, and absorbs quickly. A little goes a long way so this container lasts me a while!
A little too rich for my skin. Feels like it left a film on my face even the next morning. I just prefer something a little more lightweight.
i love how this cream feels on the skin but it eventually caused a bunch of break outs…wanted to love it, but i'll have to try something else!
Thick but not heavy like an occlusive or Vaseline. It dries super quick and isn't smelly at all.
